sections.title: Contract review
sections.sql: select source_id,name,owner,currency,amount_cents,allocated_cents,recorded_cents,status,review_on from v_contracts order by source_id

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on,source_id

sections.title: Scheduled and reviewed revenue
sections.sql: select month,currency,contract_status,sum(scheduled_cents)::bigint as scheduled_cents,sum(recorded_cents)::bigint as recorded_cents,sum(pending_cents)::bigint as pending_cents from v_revenue_review group by month,currency,contract_status order by month,currency
sections.note: Currencies stay separate. Pending consideration is not a deferred revenue or cash balance.

sections.title: Work waiting
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on,source_id

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by source_id,rule
